from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper in the collection, identified by its title and its outgoing references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers referenced in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
